```plato

    // Complex quotient. Precondition: b is non-zero.
    Divide(a: Complex, b: Complex): Complex {
        var denom = b.Real * b.Real + b.Imaginary * b.Imaginary;
        return ((a.Real * b.Real + a.Imaginary * b.Imaginary) / denom,
                (a.Imaginary * b.Real - a.Real * b.Imaginary) / denom);
    }
```

    // Divide both parts by a real factor. Precondition: scalar is non-zero.
    Divide(z: Complex, scalar: Number): Complex
        => (z.Real / scalar, z.Imaginary / scalar);

    // (a/b) / (c/d) = (ad)/(bc). Precondition: neither denominator is zero,
    // and b's numerator is non-zero.
    Divide(a: Rational, b: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(a.Numerator * b.Denominator, a.Denominator * b.Numerator);
```

    // The quotient rule: (a/b)' = (a'*b - a*b') / b^2.
    // Precondition: b.Value is non-zero.
    Divide(a: DualNumber, b: DualNumber): DualNumber
        => (a.Value / b.Value,
            (a.Derivative * b.Value - a.Value * b.Derivative) / b.Value.Square);
```

    // Dividing by a constant factor divides the derivative by it.
    // Precondition: scalar is non-zero.
    Divide(x: DualNumber, scalar: Number): DualNumber
        => (x.Value / scalar, x.Derivative / scalar);
